newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 502,700 MT fell 38 percent from the week earlier and 48 percent from the 4-week average.

Major increases for Japan (285,100 MT), Spain (118,500 MT reflecting 95,000 in new sales, 30,000 in destination changes and 6,500 in cancellations), Portugal (60,000 MT), Saudi Arabia (50,500 MT reflecting 5,900 in new sales, 50,000 tonnes in destination changes and 5,400 in cancellations), and Israel (44,500 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (73,500 MT), Taiwan (61,300 MT), and Lithuania (17,800 MT).

Exports of 1,115,700 MT were 57 percent above the week earlier and 17 percent over the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (358,200 MT), Saudi Arabia (147,100 MT), Taiwan (122,400 MT), Venezuela (80,400 MT), Egypt (77,200 MT), and Colombia (57,400 MT).
